correctness.rationale: The exact maximum 3 sqrt(3) follows from sum of three squared chords = 9 minus squared vector sum and Cauchy; equality uniquely determines pairwise dots -1/2. The aligned spherical coordinate density is explicit and smooth at that maximum. Direct symbolic differentiation of the three exact chord lengths gives Hessian block [[2 sqrt(3)/3,sqrt(3)/3],[sqrt(3)/3,2 sqrt(3)/3]] plus transverse (sqrt(3)/4)I, with determinant (sqrt(3)/4)^(d-2)>0. Compactness isolates the event; the ellipsoid volume times the exact density evaluates to C_d. Dominated convergence and Scheffe prove total-variation convergence of the aligned mark; the Beta deficit follows only in distribution. Packaged CHECK.py replays the symbolic Hessian and independently integrates finite-threshold conditional beta laws in dimensions 3,4,5,7; finite checks are not asserted to prove the limit. The exact conditional-beta integral corroborates four dimensions without substituting for the analytical limit.
